name: paypilot-monorepo
description: PayPilot — Your AI. Your Budget. Your Purchase. Autonomous AI shopping assistant powered by PayPal Sandbox and Gemini AI.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,emerald" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend

author: PayPilot Team
